declarations.name: AuiCarousel

inputs.name: slides
inputs.description: Slides: { content: Node | string, label? } (1 to 100).

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first and back.

inputs.name: autoplay
inputs.description: Rotation interval in milliseconds (at least 2000), or null.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the control labels and slide positions.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user moved to another slide: { index }.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show a slide (no event); clamped, or wrapped with loop.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Carousel (basic, with slide picker buttons): region with aria-roledescription 'carousel', slides as groups with aria-roledescription 'slide' and 'N of M' labels, rotation control first.

limitations: One slide is shown at a time.
Swiping is for touch and pen; mouse users use the buttons.
